assessments.reasoning: I checked the publisher's verified v3.13.0 tag against its exact commit, independently fetched the exact official file over HTTPS, and verified its byte digest. I read the frozen cited passage (Indentation, lines 169–216). The lexical chapter connects logical-line leading whitespace to grouping, then specifies the increasing indentation stack and the per-level token generation rules, including end of file. The sample has INDENT on two suite starts and two DEDENT tokens at EOF. No indentation token came from continuation, comment, blank or repeated-level lines. The source separately constrains tabs and form feeds.
